lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the dark lateral flank, organized into roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-luminance pixels on the upper edge to low-luminance shadow pixels below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, trailing white linear filament is visible near the posterior margin of the gill slits and the base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated dark silhouettes (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the pectoral fin and ventral body surface.
